question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CAST('2016-11-04' AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(birth_date AS TIMESTAMP))) >= 20 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CAST('2016-11-04' AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(birth_date AS TIMESTAMP))) < 30 THEN '20s'
        WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CAST('2016-11-04' AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(birth_date AS TIMESTAMP))) >= 30 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CAST('2016-11-04' AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(birth_date AS TIMESTAMP))) < 40 THEN '30s'
        WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CAST('2016-11-04' AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(birth_date AS TIMESTAMP))) >= 40 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CAST('2016-11-04' AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(birth_date AS TIMESTAMP))) < 50 THEN '40s'
        WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CAST('2016-11-04' AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(birth_date AS TIMESTAMP))) >= 50 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CAST('2016-11-04' AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(birth_date AS TIMESTAMP))) < 60 THEN '50s'
        ELSE 'others'
    END as age_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as user_count
FROM mst_users
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category
